_source: Ministry of Education / Curriculum Development Centre, Zambia — 'Civic Education (Forms 1-4) Syllabus - Scope, Content, Sequence & Curriculum Analysis Grids', Form 1 rows (items 1-19 of the document's Scope and Sequence Overview table; item 20 onward is Form 2, cross-checked against and consistent with this app's existing civic_education_form2.json). The source document is authored/compiled by a named individual, whose name, title and contact details have been removed — this file contains no identifying information, per this app's standing content policy of crediting only CDC/Ministry of Education. Unlike the scheme-of-work sources used elsewhere in this app, this scope-and-sequence table does not carry numbered CDC 'Specific Competence' outcome codes — each row gives only a Topic, Sub-Topic/Unit, and a brief 'Key Content Focus' phrase plus which term it falls in. Competency statements below are a direct paraphrase of each row's Key Content Focus into standard competency-statement form (an action verb plus the same content), not verbatim official CDC outcome text and not independently sourced content — flagged here transparently rather than presented as equivalent in authority to a numbered-outcome source. No week-level pacing was available in this source (only term), so week numbers are not set for this file.

subject.name: Civic Education
subject.description: Ordinary Level Secondary Civic Education syllabus, Form 1-4 (Curriculum Development Centre).

grade.name: Form 1
grade.phase: Secondary — the source scheme itself uses "Form 1" for this level under the 2023 CBC.

sub_topics.name: 1.1.1 Civic Education
sub_topics.description: Concept, goal and scope of Civic Education; importance of Civic Education; civic activities in school.

competencies.description: Explain the concept, goal, scope and importance of Civic Education, and identify civic activities in school

sub_topics.name: 1.2.1 Zambia's Political Development (1890-date)
sub_topics.description: Path to independence; political evolution from 1964 to present; school administrative profile.

competencies.description: Describe Zambia's path to independence and its political evolution from 1964 to the present, and outline the school's administrative profile

sub_topics.name: 1.2.2 Symbols of National Identity
sub_topics.description: National Flag, Coat of Arms, National Anthem, Independence Day, National Motto; respect for symbols.

competencies.description: Identify Zambia's symbols of national identity (Flag, Coat of Arms, National Anthem, Independence Day, National Motto) and demonstrate respect for them

sub_topics.name: 1.3.1 Concept of Governance
sub_topics.description: Family and school governance; government vs governance; systems (democracy, dictatorship, monarchy).

competencies.description: Explain the concept of governance at family and school level, distinguish government from governance, and describe systems of governance (democracy, dictatorship, monarchy)

sub_topics.name: 1.3.2 Characteristics of Good and Bad Governance
sub_topics.description: Transparency, accountability, rule of law vs corruption, nepotism, oppression.

competencies.description: Distinguish characteristics of good governance (transparency, accountability, rule of law) from bad governance (corruption, nepotism, oppression)

sub_topics.name: 1.4.1 Citizenship (Concept, Rights & Duties)
sub_topics.description: Meaning of citizenship; rights, duties, responsibilities of a Zambian citizen.

competencies.description: Explain the meaning of citizenship and the rights, duties and responsibilities of a Zambian citizen

sub_topics.name: 1.4.2 Factors Hindering Good Citizenship
sub_topics.description: Poverty, ignorance, corruption, negative peer pressure, etc.

competencies.description: Identify factors that hinder good citizenship (poverty, ignorance, corruption, negative peer pressure)

sub_topics.name: 1.5.1 Special Groups & Social Justice
sub_topics.description: Vulnerable groups (disabled, elderly, children); practising kindness, empathy, fairness.

competencies.description: Identify vulnerable groups in society (persons with disabilities, the elderly, children) and practise kindness, empathy and fairness towards them

sub_topics.name: 1.6.1 Structure & Organisation of a Political Party
sub_topics.description: Ruling vs opposition; party structure (NEC, PEC); functions; dramatising campaigns.

competencies.description: Distinguish ruling from opposition parties, describe a political party's structure (NEC, PEC) and functions, and dramatise a political campaign

sub_topics.name: 1.6.2 Political Party Systems
sub_topics.description: One-party, two-party, multi-party systems; advantages/disadvantages; history in Zambia.

competencies.description: Distinguish one-party, two-party and multi-party systems, weigh their advantages and disadvantages, and outline their history in Zambia

sub_topics.name: 1.7.1 Local Government in Zambia
sub_topics.description: History (native authority, urban authorities); structure (city, municipal, town councils); functions (services, rates, registration).

competencies.description: Describe the history, structure (city, municipal, town councils) and functions of local government in Zambia

sub_topics.name: 1.7.2 House of Chiefs
sub_topics.description: Role of traditional rulers in governance.

competencies.description: Explain the role of the House of Chiefs and traditional rulers in governance

sub_topics.name: 1.7.3 Central Government & Relationship with Local Government
sub_topics.description: Relationship between central and local government; shared functions.

competencies.description: Explain the relationship between central and local government and their shared functions
Explain the importance and functions of money

sub_topics.name: 1.8.2 Saving
sub_topics.description: Different ways of saving (bank, mobile money, savings groups).

competencies.description: Identify different ways of saving money (bank, mobile money, savings groups)

sub_topics.name: 1.8.3 Spending
sub_topics.description: Personal financial management; budgeting, avoiding wasteful expenditure.

competencies.description: Apply personal financial management skills, including budgeting and avoiding wasteful expenditure

sub_topics.name: 1.9.1 Concept of Risk Management
sub_topics.description: Identifying risks (health, accident, theft); ways to manage risk.

competencies.description: Identify common risks (health, accident, theft) and explain ways to manage them

sub_topics.name: 1.10.1 Entrepreneurship
sub_topics.description: Business opportunities; entrepreneur characteristics; benefits; creating a business plan.

competencies.description: Identify business opportunities and entrepreneur characteristics, explain the benefits of entrepreneurship, and outline how to create a business plan

sub_topics.name: 1.11.1 Types of Business Units
sub_topics.description: Sole trader, partnership, etc.; adapting to changing business environment.

competencies.description: Identify types of business units (sole trader, partnership) and explain how businesses adapt to a changing environment
